name: HVAC - Basic Safety
summary: HVAC Basic Safety is part of the Immerse Learn HVAC Basic Safety Micro-Credential Program and is accessible only to individuals enrolled in the program. This immersive VR simulation delivers hands-on training in essential safety practices for HVAC environments. Learners can practice proper use of personal protective equipment (PPE), identify workplace hazards, operate fire extinguishers, and follow safe tool handling procedures.
